name: Ring of Spell Consumption
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As the minor ring of spell consumption, except up to five levels of spells can be stored with a 20% chance of being consumed. Additionally, any spell of 5th level or less the wearer attempts to cast has a 10% chance of being consumed by the ring.

Casting remove curse on the wearer will allow the wearer to remove the ring and negates its magical ability. There is a 5% cumulative chance per spell level successfully stored that the ring erupts with a blast of force dealing 1d6 points per spell level stored to all creatures within 10′.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of spell storing

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
